title: Physics: Fix unwanted `shape_aabb` change

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

body: ## What problem(s) does this PR solve? - Closes #113867 ## Additional information As I said in #113867, I believe the issue to be with the expansion of the shape's AABB when it is initially added. I think there are actually two bugs: ### Bug one Located at: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/56d440ff546f1a4bf3a120d7136969f11964aea3/modules/godot_physics_2d/godot_collision_object_2d.cpp#L174-L178 The calculation to expand the AABB is based on s.aabb_cache.size, which is (0,0) when it is initially added. The following 'creeping' happens until the changed value converges: ``` - first _update_shapes(): shape_aabb.size = (20,20)` <- The size of the original AABB - second _update_shapes(): shape_aabb.size = (22, 22) # s.aabb_cache is (20,20) - third _update_shapes(): shape_aabb.size = (22.2, 22.2) # s.aabb_cache is (22,22) ``` and so on. ### Bug two Located at: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/56d440ff546f1a4bf3a120d7136969f11964aea3/modules/godot_physics_2d/godot_collision_object_2d.cpp#L201-L205 After fixing bug one, there was a second issue where the second `_update_shapes` still caused the item to be added to `BVH_Manager::changed_items`. This happened because the AABB was actually changing size when `_update_shapes_with_motion()` (called by `GodotBody2D::integrate_forces()`) was called. As the body is KINEMATIC, `_update_shapes_with_motion()` is called no matter what, even if the motion is (0,0) (like in this situation). This causes `shape_aabb.merge(Rect2(shape_aabb.position + p_motion, shape_aabb.size))` to resolve to `shape_aabb.merge(Rect2(shape_aabb.position + Vector(0,0), shape_aabb.size))` which leaves `shape_aabb.size` back to its original size. As the size has become smaller, the **BVH tree rebuilds again**, but is much slower as it is shifting everything around in an already populated tree. Visualization of bug two: ``` _update_shapes() shape_aabb.size: Correctly (22,22) _update_shapes_with_motion() shape_aabb.size: Now (20,20) # shape_aabb.merge(Rect2(Vector(20,20) + Vector(0,0), Vector2(20,20))) is (20,20) ``` ### Profiling using perf(w/Hotspot) This was does specifically with the MRP posted in the listed PR. Before Fix (2min 44.776s): After Fix (51.739s):
